chapter: Small groups, Europe and Kansas City memories (repeated passages)
title: First meeting Lester Young in Kansas City
summary: He knew Lester from Kansas City, where he lived and married in 1932, but cannot recall their first meeting.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Had you met Lester before you joined Basie?
Do you remember when you first ran into him?
Not really. He used to come to Kansas City. I used to live in Kansas City. Did you know that? In fact, I got married in Kansas City when I was out there -- in 1932. Kansas City, Kansas.
So I guess you wouldn't remember if you really heard him play the first time, if he...
